canonical.name: Chebyshev already gives the weaker O(1/k) majority-error bound before the page upgrades to Chernoff amplification.
Independent majority repetition yields inverse-polynomial error once the number of trials is chosen polynomially large.
A nonzero multivariate polynomial over a field vanishes on only a bounded fraction of a finite product set, which is the exact PIT carrier needed before the coRP corollary.
PP only asks whether the acceptance probability is above one half; it does not require any fixed gap away from that threshold.
